title: Miband 4 - Feature Request: European Formatted Date
symptom: The date on the Mi Band 4 watchface is displayed in US format (e.g., 5/19), which can be confusing for users accustomed to European format (e.g., 19.5). The user requests an option to show the date in European format.
fix: The feature was implemented in the new Mi Band integration beta version 0.3 (25.08.2020), which includes support for European date format. Users can also create custom watchfaces to achieve the desired format.
evidence_quote: Now part of the new Miband integration beta [ver 0.3 (25.08.2020)](https://bigdigital.home.blog/2020/08/25/new-xdrip-now-supports-miband-5/).
